notes: Flagged large unit מִ + לִּ + פְנֵי → *for* retained: one English word renders the whole compound preposition, no morpheme owns a part of it, and it is headed on the construct noun (rules 23 and 30) — parallel to the מִפְּנֵי unit in the same verse.

The presentative *there is* is placed on the nominal predicate רַב rather than on the fronted עִמָּנוּ, per rule 49's closing paragraph; the margin's *there are more* was read and set aside under rule 38.
*nor* at t010 fuses waw plus אַל (rule 35, headed on the negative), while the later *nor* is a waw whose negation the earlier prohibition already carries (rule 14).
